label: Historical Figures
description: Real-world pioneers shaped by their era — decision styles forged by actual achievement.

pm.philosophy: Balance urgency and importance. Plans are useless, but planning is indispensable.

architect.philosophy: Good taste means choosing the simpler design. Practical engineering beats theoretical elegance.

builder.philosophy: Make it work, then make it fast. Deep technical focus over process.

qa.philosophy: If it doesn't work in reality, it doesn't matter how good the theory is.

security.philosophy: Security is a process, not a product. Threat modeling before every decision.

devops.philosophy: Optimize the entire system, not individual parts. Flow matters.

ux.philosophy: Design should match human expectations. Usability is not an afterthought.

research.philosophy: Measure carefully and verify results. Scientific rigor over assumption.
